title: Byzantine Defense Pipeline Composition & Privacy Compatibility Matrix

compositions.pairing: Additive Secure Aggregation (SecAgg) + Byzantine Defense (Krum / Median / Trimmed Mean / Bulyan)
compositions.mathematical_conflict: Additive SecAgg masks individual client vectors with zero-sum pseudo-random pairwise perturbations: \tilde{u}_i = u_i + \sum_{j > i} s_{ij} - \sum_{j < i} s_{ji}. While \sum_i \tilde{u}_i = \sum_i u_i, individual vectors \tilde{u}_i are completely randomized. Non-linear aggregators relying on coordinate sorting, medians, or L2 pairwise distances operating on \tilde{u}_i evaluate random noise rather than true gradients, corrupting the consensus update.
compositions.runtime_action: Rejected at pipeline configuration validation with InvalidPipelineConfigurationError.

compositions.pairing: Homomorphic Encryption (CKKS FHE) + Byzantine Defense (Krum / Median / Trimmed Mean / Bulyan)
compositions.mathematical_conflict: CKKS homomorphic encryption supports addition and scalar multiplication over encrypted ciphertexts without a decryption key. Coordinate sorting, argmin, and non-linear threshold comparisons cannot be evaluated over ciphertext without interactive comparison protocols or high-depth polynomial approximations that exceed standard FHE ring dimensions.
compositions.runtime_action: Rejected at pipeline configuration validation with InvalidPipelineConfigurationError.

compositions.pairing: Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) + Byzantine Defense (Krum / Median / Trimmed Mean / Bulyan)
compositions.mechanism: Client weights are sealed via AEAD or encrypted mTLS session and ingested directly into the hardware-isolated enclave memory. Plaintext weights never leave enclave boundaries. The enclave CPU evaluates non-linear robust aggregators (Krum, Median, Trimmed Mean, Bulyan) natively inside enclave memory before sealing the aggregated global weights.
compositions.runtime_action: Fully supported. TEEDriver.execute_secure_aggregation dispatches the specified method inside enclave boundary.

compositions.pairing: Differential Privacy (DP-SGD / Post-Hoc DP) + Byzantine Defense
compositions.mechanism: Local bank updates are clipped to norm bound C at each client node, bounding the sensitivity of each client vector. The robust aggregator then filters or trims malicious outliers. Calibrated Gaussian noise can be injected to achieve (\epsilon, \delta)-DP guarantees. Sensitivity is strictly bounded by the clipping threshold.
compositions.runtime_action: Fully supported. Clipping norm bounds ensure bounded inputs to Byzantine distance metrics.
